WITH drg_rows_2014 AS (
SELECT
  drg_definition,
  provider_id AS hospital_id,
  provider_city AS city,
  total_discharges,
  average_total_payments AS total_payments
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
  AND total_discharges IS NOT NULL
),
drg_total_discharges AS (
SELECT
  drg_definition,
  SUM(total_discharges) AS drg_global_discharges
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
GROUP BY drg_definition
),
city_aggregates_per_drg AS (
SELECT
  drg_definition,
  COALESCE(city, '') AS city,
  SUM(IFNULL(total_discharges, 0)) AS city_total_discharges,
  SUM(IFNULL(total_payments, 0.0)) AS city_sum_total_payments
FROM (
  -- use wildcard inpatient shards across years; caller should set _TABLE_SUFFIX filter when querying the view
  SELECT
    `drg_definition`,
    `provider_city` AS city,
    `total_discharges`,
    `average_total_payments` * IFNULL(`total_discharges`, 0) AS total_payments
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
)
GROUP BY
  drg_definition,
  city
),
top_cities_for_top_drg AS (
SELECT
  top_drg.drg_definition AS drg_definition,
  city_aggs.city AS city,
  city_aggs.city_total_discharges AS city_total_discharges,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(city_aggs.city_sum_total_payments, city_aggs.city_total_discharges) AS city_weighted_avg_total_payments
FROM (
  -- find the single DRG with highest global discharges across shards 2011-2015
  SELECT drg_definition
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
  GROUP BY drg_definition
  ORDER BY SUM(total_discharges) DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS top_drg
JOIN (
  -- city-level aggregates per DRG: sum discharges and sum of (avg_total_payments * discharges)
  SELECT
    drg_definition,
    provider_city AS city,
    SUM(total_discharges) AS city_total_discharges,
    SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) AS city_sum_total_payments
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
  GROUP BY drg_definition, provider_city
) AS city_aggs
ON city_aggs.drg_definition = top_drg.drg_definition
ORDER BY city_aggs.city_total_discharges DESC
LIMIT 3
)
SELECT
  t.drg_definition AS top_drg_definition,
  c.city,
  c.city_total_discharges,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(c.city_sum_total_payments, c.city_total_discharges) AS city_weighted_avg_total_payments
FROM
  drg_total_discharges t

  city_aggregates_per_drg c
ON
  t.drg_definition = c.drg_definition

    ORDER BY drg_global_discharges DESC

  -- Filter to records from the 2014 dataset (table is 2014-specific). Keeping a year literal for clarity.
  2014 = 2014
),

GROUP BY

  drug_name
),
top_medications_per_state AS (
SELECT
  agg.state AS state,
  agg.medication AS medication,
  agg.prescription_count_2014 AS prescription_count_2014
FROM (
  -- aggregated prescription counts per state and medication for 2014
  SELECT
    `nppes_provider_state` AS state,
    `drug_name` AS medication,
    SUM(`total_claim_count`) AS prescription_count_2014
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
  GROUP BY `nppes_provider_state`, `drug_name`
) AS agg
JOIN (
  -- per-state maximum prescription count value (lifted literal: none)
  SELECT
    state AS state,
    MAX(prescription_count_2014) AS state_max_prescription_count_2014
  FROM (
    SELECT
      `nppes_provider_state` AS state,
      `drug_name` AS medication,
      SUM(`total_claim_count`) AS prescription_count_2014
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
    GROUP BY `nppes_provider_state`, `drug_name`
  )

ON agg.state = max_per_state.state
AND agg.prescription_count_2014 = max_per_state.state_max_prescription_count_2014

WITH inpatient AS (
  SELECT
    provider_id,
    _TABLE_SUFFIX AS year,
    SAFE_CAST(AVG(average_medicare_payments * total_discharges) AS FLOAT64) AS avg_inpatient_cost_year
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
  GROUP BY provider_id, year
),
outpatient AS (
  SELECT
    provider_id,
    _TABLE_SUFFIX AS year,
    SAFE_CAST(AVG(average_total_payments * outpatient_services) AS FLOAT64) AS avg_outpatient_cost_year
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
  GROUP BY provider_id, year
),
-- total inpatient cost across all years per provider (sum of average_medicare_payments * total_discharges per row)
provider_inpatient_total AS (
  SELECT
    provider_id,
    SUM(average_medicare_payments * total_discharges) AS total_inpatient_cost_2011_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
  GROUP BY provider_id
),
top_provider AS (
  SELECT
    provider_id
  FROM provider_inpatient_total
  ORDER BY total_inpatient_cost_2011_2015 DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(i.year, o.year) AS year,
  i.avg_inpatient_cost_year AS yearly_avg_inpatient_cost,
  o.avg_outpatient_cost_year AS yearly_avg_outpatient_cost
FROM top_provider tp
LEFT JOIN inpatient i
  ON tp.provider_id = i.provider_id
LEFT JOIN outpatient o
  ON tp.provider_id = o.provider_id AND i.year = o.year
-- include years where outpatient exists but inpatient might be NULL (and vice versa)
WHERE COALESCE(i.year, o.year) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY year

-- Count stations that had >=90% of possible valid temp-record days in 2019,
-- where station's record began on or before 2000-01-01 and continued through at least 2019-06-30.
WITH stations_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    usaf,
    wban,
    CONCAT(usaf, '-', wban) AS station_id,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', begin) AS begin_date,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', `end`) AS end_date
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE
    begin IS NOT NULL
    AND `end` IS NOT NULL
    AND SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', begin) IS NOT NULL
    AND SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', `end`) IS NOT NULL
    AND SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', begin) <= DATE '2000-01-01'
    AND SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', `end`) >= DATE '2019-06-30'
),
-- daily gsod files are in noaa_gsod (table per year), use the 2019 file
gsod_2019 AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(STATION_NUMBER AS STRING) AS station_number,
    CAST(SUBSTR(STATION_NUMBER, 1, STRPOS(STATION_NUMBER, '-') - 1) AS STRING) AS usaf,
    CAST(SUBSTR(STATION_NUMBER, STRPOS(STATION_NUMBER, '-') + 1) AS STRING) AS wban,
    CONCAT(CAST(SUBSTR(STATION_NUMBER, 1, STRPOS(STATION_NUMBER, '-') - 1) AS STRING), '-', CAST(SUBSTR(STATION_NUMBER, STRPOS(STATION_NUMBER, '-') + 1) AS STRING)) AS station_id,
    DATE(year, month, day) AS date,
    temp,
    max,
    min
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE
    -- keep rows where temp, max, min are not null and not sentinel missing values (e.g., 9999.9)
    temp IS NOT NULL AND max IS NOT NULL AND min IS NOT NULL
    AND temp != 9999.9 AND max != 9999.9 AND min != 9999.9
),
valid_days_per_station AS (
  SELECT
    s.station_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT g.date) AS valid_days_2019
  FROM
    stations_filtered s
  JOIN
    gsod_2019 g
  ON
    s.station_id = g.station_id
  GROUP BY
    s.station_id
),
possible_days_per_station AS (
  -- For 2019 (non-leap year) possible days = 365,
  -- but if station's record starts after 2019-01-01 or ends before 2019-12-31,
  -- adjust to count only days within both 2019 and station's available period.
  SELECT
    s.station_id,
    DATE_DIFF(
      LEAST(DATE '2019-12-31', s.end_date),
      GREATEST(DATE '2019-01-01', s.begin_date),
      DAY
    ) + 1 AS possible_days_2019
  FROM
    stations_filtered s
  WHERE
    NOT (s.begin_date > DATE '2019-12-31' OR s.end_date < DATE '2019-01-01')
),
station_rates AS (
  SELECT
    p.station_id,
    p.possible_days_2019,
    COALESCE(v.valid_days_2019, 0) AS valid_days_2019,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(v.valid_days_2019, 0), p.possible_days_2019) AS fraction_valid
  FROM
    possible_days_per_station p
  LEFT JOIN
    valid_days_per_station v
  USING (station_id)
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS stations_with_at_least_90_percent
FROM
  station_rates
WHERE
  possible_days_2019 > 0
  AND fraction_valid >= 0.90

  COUNT(1) AS questions_asked,
  SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
             COALESCE(
               (SELECT creation_date FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a WHERE a.parent_id = q.id ORDER BY creation_date ASC LIMIT 1),
               TIMESTAMP "1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC"
             ),
             q.creation_date,
             MINUTE) <= 60
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answered_within_1_hour,
  ROUND(100.0 * SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
             COALESCE(
               (SELECT creation_date FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a WHERE a.parent_id = q.id ORDER BY creation_date ASC LIMIT 1),
               TIMESTAMP "1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC"
             ),
             q.creation_date,
             MINUTE) <= 60

SELECT
  q.id AS question_id,
  q.title,
  q.body,
  LENGTH(q.body) AS body_length,
  COALESCE(u.reputation, 0) AS asker_reputation,
  COALESCE(u.up_votes, 0) - COALESCE(u.down_votes, 0) AS asker_net_votes,
  COALESCE(b.badge_count, 0) AS asker_badge_count,
  q.accepted_answer_id
FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u
  ON q.owner_user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(1) AS badge_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.badges`
  GROUP BY user_id
) b
  ON u.id = b.user_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  -- accepted answer exists
  SELECT 1
  FROM UNNEST([q.accepted_answer_id]) AS aa
  WHERE q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL
)
OR EXISTS (
  -- no accepted answer, but has at least one answer with score/view_count > 0.01
  SELECT 1
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
  WHERE a.parent_id = q.id
    AND q.accepted_answer_id IS NULL
    -- cast view_count to numeric if it's string in answers table; handle nulls and zeros
    AND SAFE_DIVIDE(a.score, NULLIF(CAST(a.view_count AS FLOAT64), 0)) > 0.01
)
ORDER BY body_length DESC
LIMIT 10
